newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Capital Asia plans warrants placement.
newsitem.headline: Capital Asia plans warrants placement.

text.p: Capital Asia Ltd said it plans to place 38.2 million 1996-97 warrants and 38.2 million 1996-98 warrants to private investors at HK$0.655 each for a net of HK$46.8 million to repay loans and raise working capital.
The warrants would entitle holders to subscribe for Capital Asia shares at a one for one basis anytime after the date of issue and before expiracy, the company said on Wednesday.
Exercise price for the 1996-97 warrants was HK$0.74 each and the holders who exercise the warrants would also receive one new 1997-98 warrant free of charge for every two 1996-97 warrants.
The 1997-98 warrants could be exercised at HK$0.79 each.

If all warrants were exercised, a total of 95.5 million new shares would be issued, representing about 20 percent of the company's existing issued share capital and 16.67 percent of its enlarged share capital, Capital Asia said.
The warrant proposal was subject to shareholders' approval at an extraordinary gerneral meeting set on October 22.
Shares of Capital Asia was stood at HK$1.23, down one cent, in Wednesday morning trade.
